scope: Prevent typed DXF or DWG output from silently dropping nonempty DRW_Mesh::subdivVertices while its wire mapping remains disputed.

autodeskDxf.publishedFields: Group 91 is described as number of subdivision levels; group 92 is the vertex count of level 0; group 10 gives vertex positions.
autodeskDxf.interpretation: The public table does not identify a separate subdivVertices vector. It does not specify the DWG body layout.

libreDwg.candidateLayout: FIELD_BL(num_subdiv_vertex, 91), followed by FIELD_3DPOINT_VECTOR(subdiv_vertex, num_subdiv_vertex, 10), then FIELD_BL(num_vertex, 92).
libreDwg.limitation: The surrounding schema comment calls the MESH fields undocumented/unstable. The peer field interpretation conflicts with Autodesk's DXF group-91 description and has no nonzero physical witness in the checked corpus.

physicalCensus.result: All eight physical MESH records use zero for the peer's candidate group-91 vector count. These records cannot determine the layout or meaning of a nonzero vector.

research.expandedCensusResult: The complete local corpus scan found 16 unique MESH records across eight unique DWG byte streams. Verbose traces report group-91 candidate vector counts [0,0] for each stream. No nonzero profile was found; see the expanded receipt for coverage and exclusions.

implementation.guard: DRW_Mesh::validateGeometry rejects a nonempty subdivVertices vector; both typed output routes validate geometry before writing, so the DXF and every supported DWG writer revision refuse before stream mutation.
testCoverage: ASCII and Binary DXF writer controls verify atomic refusal for one caller-supplied subdivision vertex.
DWG writer controls verify atomic refusal for one caller-supplied subdivision vertex across AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032.
After refusal, clearing the DXF model retries successfully with a fresh writer in both encodings; clearing the DWG model retries on the same output streams for all six writer revisions.
Existing base-cage output and parser checks remain unchanged.

limitations: No nonzero physical source was found to adjudicate the candidate group-91 vector layout.
The guard does not implement or qualify subdivision-vector import/export; locate a conforming producer sample and establish field meaning before adding a route.
No support claim was promoted, and no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
